minors.title: a 5xx from /score or /gen makes check die with a traceback instead of its own failure line
minors.detail: Line 237 (`score = client.score(_CHECK_PROBE_TEXT)`) and line 247 (`client.generate(...)`) are the first calls check makes to routes that can answer 503: a service started with --render-only returns 503 for both, and _request turns a 5xx into a raised RuntimeError after three attempts rather than a value check() can report. Verified with a stub server that answers /health as render-only (score_train_key/gen_train_key/temperature null) while the frozen setting has an inject section: check prints the three health mismatch lines and the /render line, then raises `RuntimeError: http://.../score: no score checkpoint is loaded (--render-only)` out of main(); /gen is never reached. The exit code is still 1 and the URL is in the message, so jobs/launch.py's service_check gate still fires correctly — that is why this is minor, not important — but the run costs ~3 s of retry backoff per route and the clean "print the field, exit non-zero" output pattern the rest of check uses is lost for that case.

minors.title: /score label is only checked non-empty, weaker than M-M5's "a label from the checkpoint's labels"
minors.detail: Line 241 is `label_ok = isinstance(label, str) and label != ""`. Ticket 07's M-M5 (around line 455) asks for a label from the checkpoint's `labels`. A service that returns a garbage but non-empty class name — a wrong checkpoint whose train_key happens to match, or a label field filled from the wrong tensor — passes this check. It cannot be tightened inside these two files: contracts 7.2's GET /health row and the ticket's echo line both list twelve fields with no `labels`, and the class list lives only in the checkpoint's best/meta.json, which check never opens. Closing it needs a contract/errata decision to add a thirteenth /health field; recorded here so the owner sees the gap rather than as a defect in the fix.
